_doc: Ground truth for scripts/evaluate.py. Frame indices are 0-based and inclusive. A make's window spans the final approach to the rim through the ball's exit from the bottom of the net. A clip is evaluated only once every shot's outcome is MAKE or MISS (use "?" while unlabeled). Clip-level fields: "split" ("dev" = development data, may be tuned on; "test" = held out, never tuned on), "source" (group, repo/url, license, camera), "duplicate_of" (same footage as another clip; excluded from --report counts). Shot-level "miss_type" for misses: front_rim, back_rim, in_and_out, side_rim_out, airball, other.
